content: Are there any examples of building multiple books (using the manual genre) with a shared landing page?

Not at the moment.

What are you looking to do in the landing page? Is it just a list of links to the books, or should it have some features that integrate with the book content (e.g. a search box that includes all of their content, or automatically-updated table of contents for each)?

I wanted just a list of links to start. E.g. I have several files with #doc (Manual) "Vol X" => ... and I'm looking to write something analogous to Verso.Genre.Manual.manualMain, but that takes a list of Verso.Doc.Part Manual.

What about making a website (in the Blog genre) that has a page with traditional links in it, together with a build script that builds each book into its own subdirectory of the output? Is having them all generated together an important part of what you're looking to do?

This seems fine, but I'm a bit fuzzy on the details. How do I indicate subdirectories for each book? How do I write the links in the Blog genre so that these links work locally for the output directory?

For the links, if you know where the files will be hosted then you can use ordinary Markdown link syntax.

As far as indicating subdirectories go, you can set that in each book's config or pass it as command-line arguments to the executables that generate the HTML.

Something fancier is definitely possible, but I'm not sure the complexity pays for itself here.
